skipped_areas.reason: Ion literals and Ion-specific type behavior are outside logq's JSONL and fixed-log data model.
PartiQL bag literals and bag operators are explicitly out of scope.
PIVOT is explicitly out of scope for this release.
UNPIVOT is not implemented by the parser or execution engine.
Graph pattern matching is experimental upstream and outside a log-query CLI's supported subset.
Upstream global variables and FROM-value iteration cannot be represented as logq file tables.
The upstream coercion/error evaluation-mode matrix has no logq equivalent.
logq does not implement the upstream schema-based static-analysis layer.
PartiQL DATE/TIME literal constructors differ from logq's parsed log timestamps.
LIMIT is covered, but OFFSET is not currently implemented.
Nested collection iteration in FROM requires the upstream in-memory environment model.
Projection aliases are parsed but the current JSON output retains the source field name.
Simple GROUP BY cases pass, but aggregate expressions in HAVING currently fail during streaming execution.
IN and ORDER BY pass independently; the combined form currently leaves the ORDER BY clause unconsumed.
Equivalence fixtures use Ion bags and global environments; equivalent log-backed cases should be added separately.
